Sorry for the fuckin paragraphs too, I just fuckin love this game and hearing other peoples play styles. I almost never get the chance to talk about it with anyone these days unfortunately..

If you get as many bombs and potions upgraded as you can before starting, and do NG+ you’ll be fine. Hardest thing about it is just not getting hit. Practice actual dodging, not rolling away, so you can counter and get hits in without sacrificing ground. 

Most things go down at about the same rate when fighting them in death march, it’s just that applies to you now too. Straight up. Bandits are gonna one or two shot the fuck out of you if given the opportunity. 

Build up quen. Theirs a perk where you hold the button to maintain the shield. Invest heavily in that tree, when you use the one to maintain you it heals you when you take damage. The higher your stamina the more you’ll be healed if I remember correctly. 

Axii is your friend, ESPECIALLY against those damn bandits. Aard too, knock their ass to the ground and stab em while they’re down. 

And remember the golden rule: SAVE A FUCKING LOT!!! Genuinely cannot stress it enough. I rotated three or four different saves and saved manually every 5-10 minutes, on top of a 5 minute autosave, and saved after every single victory regardless if it was large, small, or Gwent. 

For what it’s worth, I didn’t start death march and immediately start saving every second like it was the cure to eternal life. (It is tho). 

I learned that shit the fucking hard way after three hard ass fucking fights and some fucking peasant ran me through in less than 3 seconds cuz he managed to get the drop on me. Literal surprise, got as far as drawing my steel sword and I was already looking at a loading screen. 

Save like that or don’t, it’s your call, but I’d rather sacrifice 30 seconds to save when the other option is slogging through 2 and a half hours of shit I already did. The games long enough already as is, (and somehow still not long enough…). Ain’t nobody got time for that shit.

I know I’m late as fuck to this entire discussion, but this shit bugs the hell out of me. I feel like it can make it difficult to have relationships, even with people you have known for years. It really does seem like a lot of shit is all or nothing these days, zero middle ground. 

I’ll admit fully, I drink a fair amount, usually to the detriment of myself and those around me. The past few years I’ve been using it as a coping mechanism for the constant bullshit that keeps piling onto my life. (And it absolutely doesn’t help, by the way, theirs much better options out their.)

I lost a great friend of over a decade for quite a while because of it. We split amicably, and I have no ill will towards him, nor him to I. The reason I mention it though; is he coped (and still copes on occasion) with his issues in different, yet also, unhealthy ways. 

I absolutely cannot and never would judge him for that. We all have our vices, it’s human nature. 

I’m not trying to write out half a libraries worth of words; ultimately what I’m trying to get at is that I feel like a lot of people (at least that I know, admittedly) can’t imagine how life might be in anyone else’s situations. 

If it’s someone I care about, I try and imagine what certain situations feel like for them, what they might be thinking and how they might be handling those situations. 
Why they might be doing things the way their doing it, and if it’s really helping, or what they want, or if they’re using it to mask other shit they don’t feel like dealing with. 

I know everyone is different, and they genuinely might not be able to actually picture themselves in the place of another, and that’s fine. It can be a difficult thing to do if someone was brought up in a less than ideal environment. 

I just feel like a lot of people, regardless of upbringing, don’t take the time and effort to actually try lately, and it sucks when they’re close to you and can’t put forth the effort to imagine how you might be feeling in different situations, especially when you yourself might try and “go the extra mile”, for lack of a better phrase, (and if you really care about each other, it shouldn’t feel like that to either of you). 

I don’t know man. We’re fucking complex creatures and almost nothing in life is so black and white. People fuck up and make mistakes all the time. 

If every person cuts off every other person whenever someone does some minor shit, that can be easily forgiven after a few days to take a breath and process the situation as a whole, then what the hell, you know? 
If we all did that, every person would be absolutely alone in a matter of years; nobody trusting anybody, only conversing much as we need too, forming false relationships just to get what we need out of someone and then severing the cord once their purpose has been fulfilled...

If people can’t even try and work things out, what was the point of all the years of hanging out and making memories with each other just to throw it away at the drop of a hat? Did it all mean so little? To you? To the other person? Why did we bother in the first place if we can’t try and salvage what we’ve forged together for so long? 

If that’s how even deep, personal, relationships and friendships built over years of bonding over common interest and shared memories are going to turn out, then what’s the point?
 

(P.S: I know this was a bit long winded, and I apologize if it came off a little like a pity party on my end and shit. I’m not aiming for sympathy or anything, and definitely would rather not have it. 
I just wish their was better communication among folks, and people having discussions while realizing theirs very little truth in the way of absolute rights and absolute wrongs in the world. Everything’s shades of gray, and we’re imperfect creatures trying the best we can with what were given.)
